Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a two-vehicle collision on a Houston, Texas roadway where a low-speed head-on impact
had occurred between the two vehicles. Driver 1 was operating the first vehicle, which was registered to and insured
under the policy held by Driver 1. Driver 2 was operating the second vehicle. A Passenger was also seated in the first
vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was evaluated at the scene. The
reported injury is cosnistent with the mechanism of a collision of this kind. Witnesses at the scene, photographs taken
by responding personnel, and statements from Driver 2 all corroborate the account of how the collision occurred. Both
officers and witnesses confirmed that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle when the impact took place. Damage to the front
of the first vehicle and the rear of the second is largely consistent with the described impact. Some older scratches
were noted on the first vehicle's bumper, which may predate this collision and were recorded for reference only.
